notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
[h2][b]Mark the date.[/b] [b]Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd.[/b] [i]A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.[/i][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Elylah returns[/b] — wounded, radiant, and relentless. Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures. And you are not ready.[/p][p]This new installment brings:[/p][list][*][p]Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.[/p][/*][*][p]A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.[/p][/*][/list][p]The fugue is a spiral. You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend. [/i] [i]The stage is set. The curtain trembles. 

[/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841380/Fugue_of_Delights/?beta=0" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff003c"] Fugue of Delights - Store Page[/url][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195029/3c1a3f8a696d46eaa6ccd05b86c52c25a2a5c25b.png"][/img][/p]
